title: Public SFU relay directory
description: One entry per volunteer-operated relay. Machine-checkable facts (reachability, uptime, load) are probed hourly and never declared here; this file carries only what a probe cannot see. The relay's HTTPS origin is the entry's identity.

url.description: Base URL of a telium-sfu. Bare HTTPS origin: no path, query, credentials or trailing slash. Browsers probe relays from a secure page, so http:// is not listable.

name.description: What the relay is called, shown to guild owners picking one.

description.description: One sentence. Say who it is for and anything a caller should know.

capacity_band.description: The operator's declared uplink. Self-declared like a server's size band, and cross-checked by the load the probes observe. The relay's own admission ceilings are set in its sfu.toml, not here.

contact.description: How guild owners reach the operator. Shown as text, never turned into a link.

weight.description: Damps automatic selection: 3 for relays with a long track record and real headroom, 1 by default. A damping factor, never a share quota.

pubkey_hint.description: Optional key hint carried to clients; nothing reads it yet.

opt_in.description: Consent to appear in the signed feed servers fetch. Omit it or set opt_in=false to stay directory-only: listed on the website, never suggested to automatic mode.

added.description: The day the PR landed, as YYYY-MM-DD. Backdating cannot skip the observation period; the probe history enforces that independently.
